title: Baidyanath — Depth & Specificity Research
content:
Baidyanath is India's most trusted brand for Ayurvedic treatment, producing a wide range of Ayurvedic products including tablets, syrups, capsules, oils, and wellness supplements. The company has a significant marketing initiative called "Sahi Vidhi, Behtar Immunity" for its Chyawanprash, launched during the COVID-19 pandemic. Baidyanath operates as a privately held company founded in 1917, with headquarters in both Kolkata and Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, India. The company's products are sold at over 100,000 retail outlets and include herbal supplements, classical Ayurvedic formulations, personal care products, and wellness teas.
